key_insight: VeriPIE combines text-to-SQL generation with theorem-prover-checked query plans and evidence-based candidate selection to make generated computations more reviewable and trustworthy.
engineering_relevance: This is relevant for high-stakes analytics because it adds symbolic validation, repair diagnostics, and disagreement evidence before a SQL query is trusted or executed.
method: Generate both direct SQL and a structured QuerySketch plan.
Check plans with a Lean-based symbolic backend and use diagnostics to repair malformed plans.
Use execution agreement and bounded searches for distinguishing databases to rank candidates.
evidence_signal: On Spider development, VeriPIE reports 72.05% test-suite accuracy and 78.43% two-query shortlist coverage; on BIRD it reaches 68.90% execution accuracy and 73.73% two-query coverage.
watch_item: The system provides evidence about the generated computation, but it does not prove the query matches the user’s intent, so human review is still needed.
paper_title: VeriPIE: Checkable Query Plans and Evidence-Guided Selection for Text-to-SQL
